capabilities: Share notes as view-only, editable, or invited-collaborator links
Edit notes collaboratively in real time with cursors and presence indicators
Import shared notes or folders into a vault and watch them for updates
Publish a folder of Markdown files with an encrypted index
Manage links, identities, and servers, including self-hosted ones
extras: Freemium hosted service with quota limits; the README warns it is not wholly zero-knowledge because the relay can read live collaboration text unless the opt-in encrypted live editing is enabled, and that colab_* frontmatter properties contain access secrets.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to share a note with other people or edit one together live across vaults and browsers.

relations.evidence: Typing disappears while another sync plugin is active: update SimpleSync to version 0.1.28 or later
Live Yjs collaboration text is decrypted and visible to the relay while the room is active

requires.name: Note Colab hosted server or compatible self-hosted server

summary: Note-sharing plugin that publishes Markdown notes or folders as links with real-time collaborative editing in Obsidian or the browser.
